summary.zh-CN: 反向传播沿计算图从损失向前追踪影响，用链式法则高效算出每个参数对损失的梯度。
summary.en-US: Backpropagation traces influence backward through a computation graph from the loss and efficiently computes the gradient of the loss with respect to every parameter using the chain rule.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 它先让网络完成一次前向计算，再从损失向前复用局部导数，得到所有参数的梯度；参数更新由优化器完成。
coreConclusion.en-US: The network first performs a forward pass. Backpropagation then reuses local derivatives from the loss backward to obtain every parameter gradient; the optimizer performs the parameter update.
